steps.content: The room is now devoid of any sources of light from inside. Under the faint light from outside, a huge shadow emerges.
It's spurred by the murderous intent of the assassin behind it.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Why is that kid here? Send him home, or else I'll kill you.

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Has Rustfire fallen so low that you want to send a kid like that to battle?
The sharp tip of the quill pen gleams in the cold light and edges toward Raven's neck again, but Raven just smiles.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I already knew it was you back in the mine. I certainly didn't have enough ink to stop so many monsters.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I don't know how he came, but as for why... You were there, too. Didn't you hear everything?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Ica wants to avenge his parents, who got captured by Executive Officers and died in jail. That ordeal transformed the child into a warrior.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: The darkness affects every Syndican equally, so everyone has the right to fight back. Right, Crache?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Or, does the guardian of the Homeless think that kid's not worthy enough to fight?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You're the one who incited them!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You shamelessly wrote and spread all that propaganda about fighting injustice and taking back Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Oh, so you read what I wrote! Don't you find it passionate and riveting?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's a crock of rubbish! You made this mess, and now hundreds of armed execs and two armored mechs are attacking the Drifter Camp! So many in the camp just died from Mania. What are you going to fight against the Executive Committee with?!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Of course we can't rely on the Drifter Camp alone. But there's no shortage of people who want to get rid of the Executive Committee and take back Syndicate, right? I put the ruins of that mech on the front page. A victory like that can really boost morale.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You're inciting a bunch of delusional fools to die!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Only those who wanted to fight in the first place can be incited, and those are precisely the heroes whose awakening I want to witness. If they're determined to go to war, who am I to disagree?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Oh, I get it now... Your little Homeless pals got incited, too? All those cute little Sinners went to help?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Oh, they really went? Haha, no wonder Julien's still alive. It's been a while since I've seen them. I'm glad how capable they've become.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I guess that makes sense. Everyone except you used to be so sweet to their teacher. The Homeless all love me, right? Ouch, that hurts...
The shadows strangling her throat grow even tighter.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...You've got some nerve to mention that.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Why not? I look fondly upon those times... Ouch, loosen up a bit...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: My whole purpose of coming to Rustfire was to open a school. I took good care of you guys. I wrote all the teaching materials myself.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Syndicate Academy</color>... isn't it great? I can realize my dream and protect the Homeless at the same time. Giving them knowledge is giving them strength. That way, they won't ever be misled or bullied again, right?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You let all those naughty kids come to me because you also think that, no? What, you took everyone away just because I went to do some work in Eastside?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You made everyone skip class and damaged school facilities. Alas, is this how you repay my kindness? You really know how to break a teacher's heart.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Quit acting. If I had known your real motive, I never would have believed those lies.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: Supplies are short, but if we work hard, we can still afford to support a few dozen kids. More importantly...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: They all show a lot of potential—angry, unyielding, and trusting of each other. A couple of them are powerful Sinners. The next generation of Syndicate all believe in her.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: They'll become the best Rustfire warriors of the future...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Your little plot can't escape the ears of the shadows. The gangs who oppress the Homeless are indeed scum, but the hypocrite who exploits them is even worse!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...Are you angry because I remind you of <color=#fb9259>Yagyu</color>? The one who used to call you "daughter"?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You spied on me?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I'm not only a teacher, but also a journalist. Of course I'd know that.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <size=31>You loathe Syndicate. You want to keep the Homeless away from strife, away from the center of the storm, and away from a world where violence endlessly repeats itself. You don't believe that the grownups who messed up this place can make it better.</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: But not all grownups are your enemies. A lot of people want to shatter and transform this dark jungle where violence reigns supreme. All they need is the chance, and the flag to rally around.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <size=29>You see how many people my little leaflets resonated with? They defend Drifter Camp precisely because they can't bear it any longer and yearn for change. The silent ones have come forward with the same desire as yours. Now they finally have the courage to do something about it.</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't you think this will usher in the real change?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Ha... you don't like violence, do you? Then you also know nothing about Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Even if you incite everyone in the city who "wants change" to be your cannon fodder, nothing will change for the better.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Everyone says they hate violence, but violence has already been ingrained in their souls. The more you want to realize a dream, the more shortcuts you're willing to take. All these years, the fastest shortcut in Syndicate has always been violence.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: As someone who's willing to become cannon fodder, and incites others to do the same, don't you realize you're no different?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Rustfire hasn't found a way to change things at all. You're bound to fail. Just wait and see.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...It's so sad to hear these words from a kid like you.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's because you don't read enough.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What did you say—ahhh!!

<size=31>A jet-black blade suddenly shoots out from her shadow, splitting open a nearby oil lamp. The flames that spilled out light up a corner of the room. The shadows binding Raven loosen up as several blades fly towards Crache, forcing her to jump back.</size>
But as soon as she lands, the bookshelf behind her suddenly shakes. Black streaks shoot out of the pages of the books, turning into a pitch-black raven that attacks Crache.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Get lost!
Shadows split into thin threads and tear the raven to shreds, then move Crache through the air to a truly safe place.

Raven has completely freed herself from Crache's clutch. In the tiny room, the black ink finally disentangles from the black shadows. The two sides lash out at each other's necks almost simultaneously, then halt at the same time.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: When did you hide the ink in my shadow?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Haha, gonna accept that you lost to me fair and square? If not, then blame yourself for being both stubborn and uneducated. Can't believe someone like this has the nerve to skip class...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You're still so naive, little guardian. You can't outwit a grownup.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...I dare you to try it again!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <size=44>No, thanks.</size>
Raven reaches out and effortlessly grabs the shadow trying to attack her neck.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: We're really made for each other. We both manipulate dark substances, tread the darkness, and live in this broken land. You became my favorite student the moment I saw you.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You're the most bipolar child I've met. You can't see the light, nor can you fall into the darkness. You've been struggling alone all these years. You're a lot like my friends, so miserable and adorable at the same time.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: When this war is over, take the children back to class. After my mission ends, I won't need to travel anymore. I'll rebuild Syndicate Academy and teach you well.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Believe it or not, I didn't create the school to trick you into fighting. I want you to live and grow up in peace. I have only one real purpose for opening that school...
Crache freezes, and in that moment, Raven suddenly yanks the shadow, almost tipping Crache over.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: As Syndicate's great romantic poet, I must personally teach my works to my students, who will spread them to the world. That way, my poems will be immortalized for all eternity...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...I gotta pull out your tongue, you lying bastard!
Knock... knock... Someone knocks on the door.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Ehh...
After realizing who it is, Crache flashes a look of fear. As she steps back into the shadows, she spits out one last vicious threat.

steps.speaker: Message in the Shadows
steps.content: I'll pull it out next time. You better watch out. The shadows have eyes on you.
She disappears.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Acting all tough in front of me but fleeing at the sight of him. What's there to be afraid of? Such a little cutie.
steps.female_content: Acting all tough in front of me but fleeing at the sight of her. What's there to be afraid of? Such a little cutie.

steps.content: She goes quiet after saying that. The knocking continues. Raven ponders for a while with her head lowered, then shakes her head and sighs. She changes her clothes, tidies up her things and puts out the fire.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: All right, come in.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Someone came to have a heart-to-heart chat with me just now. Sorry for the wait. Where are those two kids of yours? One of them doesn't seem to be doing that well. Did you talk to her?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...Mmm. Seems you've already made up your mind.
